prompt: Find the word which has a different sound in the part underlined.
explanation: Trong từ "answer", âm được phát âm là /ə/ (âm ơ ngắn), còn lại "bird", "first", "girl" đều có nguyên âm dài /ɜː/.

prompt: My brother enjoys __________ models of vintage cars in his free time.
explanation: Sau động từ chỉ sở thích "enjoy" ta luôn sử dụng danh động từ V-ing (enjoy doing something). Do đó chọn "building".

prompt: If you want to maintain good health, you should eat __________ junk food and exercise regularly.
explanation: "Junk food" (đồ ăn vặt/đồ ăn nhanh) là danh từ không đếm được, dùng "less" mang nghĩa ăn ít đồ ăn nhanh hơn để giữ gìn sức khỏe.

prompt: We __________ trees in the local community park last Sunday morning.
options_json: ["A. plant","B. planted","C. are planting","D. will plant"]
explanation: Dấu hiệu thời gian "last Sunday morning" (sáng Chủ nhật tuần trước) chỉ một sự việc đã diễn ra và chấm dứt trong quá khứ -> Dùng quá khứ đơn "planted".

passage: Community service is very important in secondary education. Students can participate in picking up litter, tutoring younger kids, or donating old books to rural schools. These activities not only improve social awareness but also build teamwork and empathy.
prompt: According to the passage, what is ONE benefit of participating in community service?
options_json: ["A. Earning a high salary","B. Building teamwork and empathy","C. Getting free textbooks for college","D. Avoiding examination tests"]
explanation: Thông tin nằm ở câu cuối: "These activities not only improve social awareness but also build teamwork and empathy."

passage:
The Integration of Artificial Intelligence in Contemporary Classrooms

Artificial Intelligence (AI) has rapidly transformed the educational landscape, offering personalized learning pathways tailored to individual student velocity and comprehension levels. Unlike traditional static curricula where educators deliver standardized instruction to heterogeneous groups, AI-driven adaptive software continuously assesses cognitive performance, dynamically recalibrating exercises in real time.

Critics, however, raise valid concerns regarding algorithmic bias, data privacy, and the risk of diminished interpersonal communication skills among students. Educational psychologists emphasize that while automated platforms excel at quantitative drill and content delivery, human instructors remain irreplaceable in cultivating empathy, moral reasoning, and creative discourse. As pedagogical models evolve, the most triumphant methodology appears to be a blended paradigm: AI handling diagnostic analytics and baseline skill acquisition, while skilled teachers orchestrate deep critical inquiries and collaborative problem-solving.
prompt: According to paragraph 1, how does AI-driven adaptive software differ from traditional static curricula?
options_json: ["A. It forces students to learn at the fastest peer pace.","B. It dynamically recalibrates learning exercises based on real-time cognitive assessment.","C. It removes the necessity of examination grading entirely.","D. It replaces all reading textbooks with virtual reality headsets."]
explanation: Paragraph 1 specifies: "AI-driven adaptive software continuously assesses cognitive performance, dynamically recalibrating exercises in real time."

prompt: The word "heterogeneous" in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to:
options_json: ["A. Identical and uniform","B. Highly gifted and advanced","C. Diverse and varied in nature","D. Reluctant to participate"]
explanation: "Heterogeneous" có gốc từ tiếng Hy Lạp nghĩa là không đồng nhất, đa dạng (diverse, consisting of dissimilar parts).

prompt:
WRITING TASK 2: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write about the following topic:

"Some people believe that artificial intelligence will eventually replace human school teachers in the near future. Others argue that human teachers will always be essential in the classroom.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion."

Write at least 250 words. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
explanation: Tiêu chí chấm điểm IELTS Writing: Task Response (trả lời trọn vẹn cả 2 quan điểm và nêu lập trường cá nhân), Coherence and Cohesion (bố cục 4 đoạn mở bài - thân bài 1 - thân bài 2 - kết bài logic), Lexical Resource (từ vựng học thuật C1), Grammatical Range and Accuracy (câu phức, đảo ngữ, bị động).
rubric_json: {"task_response":"Fully addresses all parts with well-developed ideas","coherence_cohesion":"Sequences information logically with clear progression","lexical_resource":"Uses a wide range of academic vocabulary with rare minor errors","grammatical_accuracy":"Uses a wide range of structures with full flexibility and accuracy"}

prompt:
SPEAKING PART 2 (Cue Card):

Describe a skill you learned that you found extremely useful.
You should say:
- What the skill was
- When and where you learned it
- How you learned it
And explain why you think this skill is particularly valuable to your daily life or career.
audio_url: speech_prompt: Describe a skill you learned that you found extremely useful. You have one minute to prepare and up to two minutes to speak.
explanation: Gợi ý cấu trúc trả lời 2 phút: Mở đầu trực tiếp (I would like to talk about mastering conversational English...), hoàn cảnh bắt đầu học, thử thách gặp phải và giải pháp, ứng dụng thực tế hiện nay và cảm xúc cá nhân.
rubric_json: {"fluency_coherence":"Speaks fluently with rare repetition or self-correction","lexical_resource":"Uses idiomatic expressions and colloquial language naturally","grammatical_range":"Uses a variety of complex structures with flexibility","pronunciation":"Uses a full range of phonological features to convey subtle meaning"}

prompt: The board of directors unanimously decided to __________ the launch of the new product until market conditions become more favorable.
explanation: Cấu trúc "decide to + V-infinitive". Sau "to" cần một động từ nguyên thể -> Chọn "postpone" (trì hoãn).

prompt: All employees travelling on company business must keep their receipts in order to receive _________ for authorized expenditures.
explanation: Sau ngoại động từ "receive" cần một danh từ tân ngữ. "Reimbursement" (khoản tiền hoàn lại/chi trả) là danh từ chính xác phù hợp với ngữ cảnh.

passage: Passage: Renewable energy systems combined with artificial intelligence are rapidly reshaping sustainable cities. By anticipating peak consumption hours, smart algorithms reduce electrical wastage by up to 34%. However, the upfront capital expenditure remains a contentious issue among municipal governments.
prompt: According to the passage, all municipal governments have agreed to fund the installation of smart AI energy systems.
explanation: Bài đọc nêu rõ: "upfront capital expenditure remains a contentious issue among municipal governments" (chi phí ban đầu vẫn là vấn đề tranh cãi), do đó nhận định tất cả chính quyền đã đồng ý là FALSE.

prompt: Which of the following headings best encapsulates the primary objective of integrated urban smart grids?
options_json: ["A. Eliminating the necessity of renewable power sources","B. Maximizing energy efficiency via algorithmic predictive distribution","C. Decreasing human workforce in urban governance","D. Accelerating commercial advertising in metropolitan areas"]
explanation: Mục tiêu trọng tâm của lưới điện thông minh AI là tối ưu hóa hiệu suất sử dụng năng lượng thông qua thuật toán phân phối dự đoán (predictive distribution).

prompt: [TOEIC PART 1 - PHOTO DESCRIPTION] Look at the image of the boardroom meeting. Which statement best describes the scene?
audio_url: speech_prompt: Look at the photograph in your test book. A. A presenter is gesturing towards a statistical bar graph on the projection screen. B. The conference attendees are exiting the auditorium. C. A technician is repairing the projector cable. D. The boardroom chairs are stacked against the wall.
options_json: ["A. A presenter is gesturing towards a graph on the projection screen.","B. The conference attendees are exiting the auditorium.","C. A technician is repairing the projector cable.","D. The boardroom chairs are stacked against the wall."]
explanation: Trong bức ảnh, diễn giả đang đứng thuyết trình và chỉ tay về phía biểu đồ phân tích trên màn hình chiếu, đúng với phương án A.

prompt: [TOEIC PART 5] The updated corporate travel policy states that meal expenses incurred __________ official business trips will be reimbursed up to $75 per diem.
explanation: "During" là giới từ đi kèm với cụm danh từ (during official business trips). Trong khi "while" và "whereas" đi với mệnh đề có chủ ngữ và vị ngữ.

passage:
Listen to a lecture in a Marine Biology class.
Professor: "Today we examine hydrothermal vent ecosystems along the mid-ocean ridges. For decades, biologists assumed that life on Earth fundamentally depended on photosynthetic energy derived from solar radiation. However, the discovery of chemotrophic sulfur-oxidizing bacteria in aphotic abyssal zones completely upended classical ecological doctrine."
prompt: [TOEFL iBT - Academic Lecture] What was the scientific consensus prior to the discovery of hydrothermal vent organisms?
audio_url: speech_prompt: For decades, biologists assumed that life on Earth fundamentally depended on photosynthetic energy derived from solar radiation.
options_json: ["A. All organic life ultimately relies on solar energy through photosynthesis.","B. Sulfur compounds were the primary energy source for ancient organisms.","C. Abyssal oceanic zones contained the highest biological biodiversity on Earth.","D. Deep sea currents prevented biological development below 2000 meters."]
explanation: Giáo sư nêu: "biologists assumed that life on Earth fundamentally depended on photosynthetic energy derived from solar radiation" -> Nhận định trước đây là mọi sự sống đều dựa vào năng lượng mặt trời.

passage: The remarkable resilience of tardigrades allows them to survive cryptobiosis under extreme desiccation, ionizing radiation, and temperatures approaching absolute zero.
prompt: [TOEFL iBT - Vocabulary in Context] The word "resilience" in the passage is closest in meaning to:
options_json: ["A. capacity to recover and endure extreme hardship","B. fragile physical composition","C. evolutionary stagnation over millennia","D. tendency to migrate across climatic zones"]
explanation: "Resilience" mang nghĩa khả năng phục hồi, chống chịu bền bỉ trước điều kiện khắc nghiệt (capacity to recover and endure hardship).

prompt: [TOEFL iBT - Inference] What can be inferred about organisms that undergo cryptobiosis?
options_json: ["A. Their metabolic activity drops to imperceptible levels without biological death.","B. They continuously consume large quantities of nutrients to survive.","C. They only exist in tropical freshwater environments.","D. Their life span is shortened dramatically when exposed to cold temperatures."]
explanation: Cryptobiosis (trạng thái đình sinh) là trạng thái trao đổi chất giảm xuống mức gần như bằng 0 mà cơ thể sinh vật vẫn không chết, giúp sống sót qua điều kiện cực đoan.
